llm_top3.reasoning: I deviate from the top quant ranks because FHN's beat was already sold and UGI's news read is outright negative (revenue miss, propane weakness, debt overhang). TSCO pairs strong price momentum and bullish options flow with a CEO buying 15,600 shares near multi-year lows — the most credible insider-confirmed turnaround signal in the list. GMED has the cleanest fundamental catalyst: revenue/EPS beat, raised EPS guidance and an upgrade to Strong Buy with wide analyst upside. MDT offers a UBS upgrade, regulatory win and a confirmed technical breakout with dividend support and low downside.

FHN.reasoning: Q2 EPS up ~20% YoY beat with Cramer buy call and Wells Fargo raising PT to $28, though shares fell on the print and valuation is less cheap.

UGI.reasoning: Q3 revenue miss, segment EBIT down on warm weather/AmeriGas propane weakness, debt-burden concerns and Wells Fargo PT cut, partly offset by reaffirmed guidance and a PA rate settlement.

ACGL.reasoning: Q2 earnings beat on reserve gains and investment income with JPM raising PT to $118, but GAAP EPS fell YoY and revenue-decline headlines pushed the stock down.

EL.reasoning: Mostly promotional Glimmer fragrance launch news and a $210M securities-settlement claims deadline; nothing clearly directional ahead of Aug 19 results.

MNST.reasoning: Stock hit a 52-week low and 'record sales meet premium doubts' with margin compression despite strong international growth; the 2-for-1 split is cosmetic.

TSCO.reasoning: Strong momentum with 17% surge/8-day win streak, CEO buying 15,600 shares near lows and bullish call flow, though the 2026 outlook cut and margin squeeze are real overhangs.

ALLY.reasoning: Revenue beat but EPS missed on $430M credit provisions, stock slid 2.4%, plus a CRO insider sale; buybacks and NIM expansion temper the negative.

FDX.reasoning: Automation/robotics rollout and heavy call buying with shares up 5% in 7 days, offset by weak guidance post-spinoff and Amazon opening freight services as a competitive threat.

DECK.reasoning: Solid Q2 with HOKA +7.7%, UGG +4.9%, DTC +13% and raised FY27 EPS guidance at ~13x earnings, but the whole footwear group is being dragged down by ONON's plunge.

ICE.reasoning: MarketAxess $6B acquisition brings antitrust/financing overhang and bond issuance, while July volumes +25% and record mortgage equity data are positives; stock is down 18% over a year.

ROST.reasoning: Printed a new 52-week high with bullish technical calls and positive fundamental write-ups, though some notes flag it as expensive after a 130% three-year run ahead of Aug 20 earnings.

DASH.reasoning: Q2 orders +27% and revenue +36% with PT raises to $220, but valuation is stretched, margins/costs rising and insiders selling.

NOV.reasoning: Q2 EPS beat (+7% YoY) despite revenue decline, stock up 49% in a year and still called undervalued, with cash-flow doubts and insider selling as offsets.

ETR.reasoning: Q2 beat with affirmed guidance, insider purchase, SMR nuclear MOU with Holtec/Hyundai and JPM PT raise to $139, though valuation is called expensive after a 144% run.

ARR.reasoning: Returned to profitability with book value up slightly to $17.53 and dividend affirmed, but mortgage REIT upside hinges on rate direction.

GMED.reasoning: Q2 revenue and EPS beat, raised non-GAAP EPS guidance, Zacks upgrade to Strong Buy and broad analyst buy ratings with ~25% upside.

CTRE.reasoning: Record $900M investment quarter at 8.9% yields, ~$1.5B deployed in 2026, revenue +43% YoY and Cantor PT raise, though FFO merely met estimates and shares dipped.

MDT.reasoning: UBS upgrade citing a turnaround, CE Mark win, breakout above 50-week MA and bullish call flow support the dividend-aristocrat re-rating story.

AKR.reasoning: Raised full-year FFO guidance on record leasing and hit a 52-week high, but a 9M-share equity offering dilutes and one shop cut it to Sell.

KO.reasoning: All-time high but valuation-stretched commentary, insider sale of 9,958 shares and no fundamental catalyst; ultra-processed-food policy chatter is peripheral.
